```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-off cleanup tool for build artifacts."""
import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("target")
    ap.add_argument("--yes", action="store_true", help="actually delete")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    target = Path(args.target).resolve()
    if not target.is_relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT):

        print(f"{len(victims)} file(s) would be deleted; re-run with --yes")
        return

    for path in victims:
        path.unlink()
    print(f"deleted {len(victims)} file(s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-off cleanup tool for build artifacts."""
import argparse
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("target", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--yes", action="store_true", help="actually delete")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    target = args.target.resolve()
    if not target.is_relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT):
        sys.exit(f"refusing to touch {target}: it is outside {PROJECT_ROOT}")

    victims = [p for p in sorted(target.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()]
    print(f"{len(victims)} file(s) would be deleted:")
    for path in victims:
        print(f"  {path}")

    if not args.yes:
        print("nothing deleted; re-run with --yes to actually delete")
        return

    for path in victims:
        os.remove(path)
    print(f"deleted {len(victims)} file(s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
